sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest FII/DII flows, regime, breadth, and index performance data.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT
  fi.trade_date,
  fi.fii_net_today,
  fi.dii_net_today,
  fi.flow_signal,
  fi.fii_trend,
  fi.dii_trend,
  rh.regime,
  rh.confidence,
  md.advances,
  md.declines,
  md.ad_signal,
  ie.index_symbol,
  ie.close
FROM
  signals.fii_dii_flows fi
JOIN
  signals.regime_history rh ON fi.trade_date = rh.trade_date
JOIN
  breadth.market_daily md ON fi.trade_date = md.trade_date
JOIN
  market.index_eod ie ON fi.trade_date = ie.trade_date
WHERE
  fi.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)
  AND ie.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
LIMIT 1;
